title: The Next waiver excuses a missing Done model only for an agent still running
why: Today any role word in Next excuses a missing Done model, so a report can drop a model name and still pass.
note: The waiver should hold only for an agent that Next names as still running, with its model. Debt: done-models-next-waiver-loose. PR stacked on #1690. Filed from lane report-model-from-role, 19:22 CST Nov 7. Built as #1721, with runner 8 with a merge-tool record for its live head (19:50 CST).
